displayTitle: Revenge of the Sith Ultimate Sticker Book
synopsis: The Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Ultimate Sticker Book is book filled with over sixty stickers of heroes, villains, spacecraft, vehicles, droids, and equipment from the Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith. It was published by Dorling Kindersley in 2005.
